# Install / 安装

Copy `ZBBZ.bundle` to:

```text
~/Library/Application Support/Autodesk/ApplicationAddins
/Applications/Autodesk/ApplicationAddins
```

Then restart AutoCAD for Mac and run `ZBBZCONFIG` or `ZBBZ`.

把 `ZBBZ.bundle` 复制到：

```text
~/Library/Application Support/Autodesk/ApplicationAddins
/Applications/Autodesk/ApplicationAddins
```

然后重启 AutoCAD for Mac，运行 `ZBBZCONFIG` 或 `ZBBZ`。
